Are you passionate about app development with integration for hardware? Do you want to become part of an experienced development team of full stack software engineers and make your mark on Kamstrup’s Field Tools? Are you ready for an exciting and educational internship in an international green-tech company?

Here is what the job entails

During your internship, you will be working with your team as well as the Product Managers in our Project Team. Together, you will be developing our application for the Windows, Android and iOS platforms. This includes communication with our meters through a serial or wireless connection.

We are developing our apps in Microsoft Visual Studio - .NET/C# from where you will be working with one or more of the following technologies during your internship:

• .NET / C#

• Cross-platform development in .NET MAUI

• XAML

• SQL / SQLite

• MVVM design pattern

• Build pipelines in GitLab

• Bluetooth and wM-Bus communication

The specific contents of your tasks will be planned according to your wishes and your competencies and will depend on the features we will implement. Experience in the technologies we use is not a requirement; the most important thing is that you are eager to learn.

Meet your future team

As our Intern in .NET App Development, you will become a part of a software team in our Water business unit - Hardware department, consisting of five Software Developers with backgrounds such as Software Engineers and Physicists. The team develops meter configuration solutions and field tool applications for Windows, Android, and iOS. We are continuously working on improving and optimizing our field tools, so they become more user-friendly. By doing so, we ensure our position as a customer-preferred partner in the field.

Did you know? Only about half of our team drinks coffee — the rest run on pure code, energy drinks, or maybe just sheer willpower.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a motivated student who is ready to work with applications and whose commitment and theoretical knowledge can contribute to further development across platforms.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are studying Software Technology (IKT), Computer Science, or similar. Most importantly, you are passionate about developing applications

• Have an analytical mindset and enjoy solving complex problems

• Are proactive in seeking knowledge and value professional sparring

• Can work independently while being a strong team player

• Bring a critical sense that enables you to establish the best decision-making

As we are an international organisation it is important that you fluent in English both orally and written. Danish will be considered an advantage.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• The internship is paid if your place of study allows it

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

Click on this link and apply now. The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

Kamstrup is located in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Manager, Product Tools & Apps, Jan Alexandersen on telephone nr.: +45 89 93 10 00.

Are you passionate about project management and technology and do you want to gain insight into professional project management? Are you ready to collaborate with engineers and project managers, while contributing to the green transition? Would you like an internship where your role can focus on either project management, technical engineering, or a combination depending on your interests and background?

An internship with a broad focus on project processes

As an intern in Customer Projects, you will gain hands-on experience with the full project process from technical preparation to customer dialogue and internal coordination. The internship offers flexibility, allowing you to focus more on either project management, technical engineering, or a combination of both, depending on your background and interests.

You will be involved in tasks such as:

• Supporting internal and external project meetings, including preparation of presentations, documentation, and follow-up

• Assisting with technical tasks such as site specifications, coverage maps, and network overview

• Participating in process optimization and transition projects to ensure scalable and efficient project execution

• Handling landowner agreements and contributing to the dialogue around network deployment

• Working with ERP systems and project tools to ensure data accuracy and process alignment

Furthermore, you will have the opportunity to influence direction and your tasks during the internship, which will ensure the optimal environment for your development.

Meet your future team

As an intern in Customer Projects, you will be part of a professionally strong department consisting of 11 Project Managers and Specialists that deliver remote reading systems for meters to our heat/cooling customers. You will be on equal footing with our project team and assist them in the implementation of customer projects all the way from contract signing to system handover. You will collaborate closely with experienced Engineers, Project Managers, and other technicians. As a department we are characterized by mutual trust and freedom to act with responsibility. We have an informal tone, where emphasis is on professional sparring and feedback.

Did you know? All Project Managers in the team have started as interns in the team.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a motivated and curious student who is eager to explore the field of project management and contribute to customer projects in a technical and international environment. Your theoretical knowledge and personal drive will help strengthen Kamstrup’s Customer Project department. Furthermore, you value professional sparring and teamwork while also being able to work independently with many ongoing projects.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are currently studying Global Business Engineering, Engineering, Business Administration, IT or another relevant field

• Have an interest in technical systems and great communication skills that allow you to clearly convey information to both customers and colleagues

• Are curious, investigative and pragmatic in problem-solving and idea generation

• Are structured and have a good understanding of importance of economic overview and control in projects

• Bring a positive mindset

As we are an international organisation it is important that you have high proficiency in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Complex international HVAC projects demand more than strong project plans. They require disciplined commercial leadership, reliable cross-functional execution, and timely decisions across markets, contracts, and technical disciplines.

NOVENCO are looking for a Director of Project Execution to lead NOVENCO’s project portfolio across Denmark, Netherlands, UK, DACH, APAC and US. You will strengthen how we deliver safely, profitably, and consistently from order handover to final customer acceptance and satisfaction.

****Your Impact

• Lead the Project Execution function across NOVENCO, ensuring safe, timely, profitable, and contractually compliant delivery.

• Set the functional direction, operating model, governance standards, and long-term capability roadmap for Project Execution.

• Own portfolio performance across revenue, gross margin, cash flow, working capital, forecasting, risk, quality, and customer commitments.

• Lead and develop Project Managers and project execution teams through clear priorities, effective decision rights, succession planning, and coaching.

• Align Sales, Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Finance, installation, and commissioning around common delivery plans and commercial outcomes.

• Guide major customer escalations, contractual negotiations, claims, recovery actions, and commercial decisions within NOVENCO’s delegated authority framework.

****What Drives Success

• Extensive leadership experience from international HVAC, mechanical contracting, EPC, construction, or industrial project delivery.

• Proven accountability for a complex project portfolio, including margin, cash, risk, forecasting, contracts, and customer escalations.

• Strong financial and organizational judgement that turns business strategy into clear priorities, governance, and executable plans.

• The ability to lead experienced professionals and Project managers across functions, cultures, countries, and competing commercial priorities.

• A relevant degree or equivalent experience; PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2, or comparable certification is an advantage.

****Real Impact Example

****A major international project portfolio is facing changing customer requirements, capacity constraints, margin pressure, and several contractual interfaces. You enable your team to establish a fact-based portfolio review, clarify decision rights, strengthen change control, and align Sales, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, and project leadership around a shared recovery plan. Within short time the team improves forecast accuracy, and brings critical projects back within their approved delivery plans. Just as importantly, the new governance becomes a repeatable standard across all four countries.

****What We Offer

• A leadership role with responsibility for international project execution across NOVENCO’s established markets.

• The opportunity to shape NOVENCO’s Project Execution strategy, operating model, leadership capability, and delivery standards.

• Direct influence on the commercial and operational performance of complex, technically demanding HVAC projects.

• Close collaboration with senior leadership and experienced colleagues across commercial, technical, financial, and operational functions.

• Professional development and training through NOVENCollege.

• 25 days’ annual leave plus 5 days Feriefri after the qualifying period.

• Standard auto-enrolment pension scheme and access to a healthcare scheme.

• Competitive salary and employee benefits in line with company policy.

****Context

****You will lead a team of 8-10 people across NOVENCO and report directly to the CEO. The position combines strategic functional leadership with regular engagement in major projects and customer relationships.

**How To Apply

**Please submit your CV via our careers site. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be scheduled as suitable candidates are identified.

NOVENCO Building & Industry is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

Are you motivated by how companies decide which products, technologies, and business opportunities to invest in? Do you enjoy combining market insight, customer needs, financial potential, and strategic analysis to support difficult decisions? Are you looking for an internship where you can contribute to strategic portfolio decisions in Kamstrup’s international Heat/Cooling business?

Here is what your role entails

As our intern, you will work closely with Strategic Portfolio Management on questions that influence the direction of the Heat/Cooling business. You will contribute to portfolio strategy, evaluate business opportunities, analyse the balance of the portfolio, and help prepare recommendations for prioritisation and investment decisions.

More specifically, you will be:

• Contributing to the annual portfolio strategy process for the Heat/Cooling business

• Mapping customer needs, market trends, competitor movements, and technology developments

• Analysing business opportunities and assessing their strategic fit and value potential

• Developing business cases, portfolio dashboards, and decision material for management reviews

• Supporting prioritisation discussions across development initiatives

You will take ownership of analytical assignments and contribute directly to ongoing portfolio decisions. At the same time, you will gain insight into how strategic choices are made across Product Management, Sales, Finance, and Research and Development.

Meet your future team

You will become part of our Product Management Team in the Heat/Cooling department, where you will work closely together with Strategic Portfolio Management. In Strategic Portfolio Management, we challenge ideas, prioritize business opportunities, and then support them as projects on their way to our customers. Using sales numbers, market input, customer interviews, and strategic priorities, we give guidance to the organization on what to build next. We do so by seeking out data and diverse perspectives to challenge each other’s assumptions. Otherwise, we enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, and we are not shy about celebrating successes and learnings along the way.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for an ambitious bachelor’s or master’s student who are curious about how companies make strategic investment decisions and motivated by analysing complex questions and turning your insights into clear recommendations.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are currently studying, or have an interest in, International Business, Business Development, Economics, Innovation Management, or Technology Management

• Have experience with Excel and PowerPoint and are comfortable working with both quantitative and qualitative information

• Are interested in how AI can be applied in your daily work

• Can structure ambiguous problems and identify the most important questions

• Communicate complex insights in a simple and convincing way and thrive when collaborating with stakeholders

As we are an international organisation it is important that you are fluent in English and Danish.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Sky‑Watch A/S is a leading Danish drone company that since 2009 has specialized in the development, production, and servicing of high‑technology mini UAS systems for Defense – nationally and internationally. With more than 155+ dedicated employees and a strong international growth journey underway, Sky‑Watch today stands as one of the most innovative players within tactical mini UAV systems. At Sky‑Watch, robust, reliable, and advanced drone systems are developed for demanding environments and critical situations where predictability, mechanical durability, traceability and user safety are paramount.

As an ambitious scale-up company in rapid development, Sky-Watch continues to expand across products, markets and the organization.

To support the company’s international growth and further strengthen the strategic level of its marketing function, we are now looking for an ambitious, strategic and inspiring

Director of Marketing

Strategic Marketing Leadership – International Defense – Commercial Impact

Do you want to shape the marketing direction of a fast-growing high-tech defense company? As Director of Marketing at Sky-Watch, you will lead and develop the marketing function across Product Marketing & Strategy, Field & Event Marketing, and Brand & Digital Influence. You will strengthen the strategic level of marketing, set clear priorities and create the framework for a multidisciplinary team of specialists to succeed. At the same time, you will connect Sky-Watch’s advanced engineering capabilities with customer needs and government procurement requirements, strengthening the company’s positioning and commercial impact in international defense markets.

Working closely with Sales, Business Development and R&D, you will ensure that marketing supports strategic procurement programs, priority accounts and Sky-Watch’s international growth ambitions.

You will report to the VP Marketing and lead a marketing team of five.

Your key responsibilities include:

• 
Product Marketing & Strategy – positioning, go-to-market strategies, technical narratives, CONOPS and tender enablement.

• 
Field & Event Marketing – international defense exhibitions, live demonstrations and targeted market activities.

• 
Visual Brand Design & Digital Influence – compelling visual communication, digital narratives and consistent brand positioning.

• 
ABM & Partner Enablement – targeted initiatives towards priority accounts, procurement programs and international partners.

• 
People Leadership – develop the marketing team and create clear direction, collaboration and ownership.

To succeed in this role, you have around 10 years of experience within Marketing and Product Marketing in international high-tech companies, preferably within a regulated industry such as aerospace or defense, combined with a few years of leadership experience. You know how to set strategic direction while empowering specialists to take ownership of execution. You bring experience with Account-Based Marketing, lead generation and partner enablement and understand customer acquisition in public tender-driven markets. Experience with technical product marketing, Tier-1 accounts, international exhibitions and complex hardware and software portfolios will be important in the role, and a strong technical understanding or flair is considered an advantage.

You are based within reasonable commuting distance of Sky-Watch’s location in Støvring or Valby.

As a person, you are a strategic and results-oriented leader with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to translate strategy into execution. You provide clear direction while giving specialists the trust and autonomy to excel within their areas of expertise. You combine strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent communication and interpersonal capabilities. You are curious, adaptable and resilient in a dynamic scale-up environment and bring a collaborative and inclusive approach to leadership. With high accountability, integrity and professionalism, you are motivated by building a strong and high-performing marketing function.

Are you the new Director of Marketing at Sky-Watch? If so, please submit your application and CV as soon as possible. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity or religion. For further information about the position, please contact consultant Martin Tveit, Sensu A/S, by phone at +45 26 83 38 42.

For more information about Sky‑Watch, please visit www.sky-watch.com.

Please note that applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and no application deadline is set.

Are you passionate about embedded software development and communication systems? Do you want to apply your theoretical knowledge in a high-tech, international company? Would you like to become a part of a cross functional development group consisting of experienced and committed colleagues?

You will be involved in a development project where you work with technology clarification, analysis, simulation, and implementation.

More specifically, you will be working with:

• Embedded software development based on our firmware development process

• Low level embedded software development in C or C++ with an object-oriented mindset, as well as test scripts in Python

• Communication protocols and protocol stacks

• Optimized embedded Software design for low power consumption

• Hardware-based programming and measurement, in an ARM Cortex-M3 based platform

Your final tasks will be adjusted to your competencies, but you will be working on real challenges that contribute to our development projects.

Meet your future team

You will become part of a tight-knit group consisting of skilled Engineers, Technicians, and PhDs with full focus on communication, that can offer valuable learnings and sparring. Our team of 10 skilled embedded software developers is characterized by an informal tone that promotes a work environment with mutual trust and freedom to act with responsibility. You will be on equal footing with the rest of the team, with your own tasks and responsibilities, which we will make sure you are well-equipped to handle.

Did you know? We do joint push-ups during the workday just for our own work happiness. But we are always open to new ideas for how to stay active and have fun together!

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a self-driven engineering student with a can-do attitude. You want to contribute to the development of Kamstrup’s devices based on your solid theoretical knowledge, but you are also eager to learn new things and new ways of working.

In order to succeed we imagine that you:

• Are studying a relevant bachelor’s degree within Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or similar

• Have strong skills within mathematics, communication theory, and software development, combined with a good understanding of electronics

• Are looking for an internship where freedom under responsibility, as well as personal and professional development are of high importance

• Have a curious, problem-solving mindset to analyze and solve problems using facts and theory

• It is a requirement that you are fluent in English both written and spoken. Danish is not a requirement.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

Job description

Are you an experienced Talent Acquisition (TA) professional with a strong track record in recruitment and proactive sourcing? Do you enjoy advising hiring managers, navigating challenging talent markets and finding specialist talent that is hard to reach? Would you like to help shape TA in a growing, international technology company?

Trackman is looking for an experienced TA Specialist to join our HR team at our headquarters in Hørsholm. TA is a newly established dedicated function within HR at Trackman. We are a small and collaborative team with responsibility for recruitment across the organisation.

Because we are a small team, everyone plays an important role. You will have a high degree of ownership and independence while working closely with your TA colleagues and the wider HR team. We are looking for someone who brings solid experience, can confidently run recruitment processes and sourcing activities independently, and is ready to contribute with ideas and best practices from day one.

You will join us at an exciting stage where we are continuing to develop our TA function, strengthen our sourcing capabilities and build more scalable ways of working. We value openness, collaboration and a good sense of humour. We help each other, share knowledge and ideas, and trust each other to take ownership.

What you will be doing

You will take ownership of recruitment processes and partner closely with hiring managers across the recruitment lifecycle, with a particular focus on identifying and engaging talent for specialist and hard-to-fill positions.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Drive recruitment processes in close collaboration with hiring managers, advising on candidate profiles, recruitment strategy, processes and market conditions.

• 
Proactively source and engage talent through LinkedIn Recruiter and other relevant channels.

• 
Build and maintain talent pipelines for critical profiles.

• 
Ensure smooth and effective recruitment operations, from engaging job ads to well-managed candidate pipelines in our ATS, Recruitee.

•

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Where innovation happens

Candidates will be evaluated on a continuous, rolling basis.

**The Role

**As a Senior Sales Specialist at Clair Scientific, you will support the commercial growth of our automated microscopy platform across multiple territories and market segments. Leveraging an extensive network spanning academia, pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, hospitals, and industrial R&D, you will identify opportunities, build strategic relationships, and drive revenue growth while helping build our global sales organization.

**

**Overview

**Corti is the frontier lab for clinical-grade AI, building world-leading models and infrastructure for the realities of healthcare.

Our technology powers healthcare’s most ambitious software, from EHR vendors and virtual care platforms to the health systems that care depends on. We work with builders ranging from fast-moving startups to global healthcare enterprises, helping them bring clinical AI into real-world care.

Healthcare is full of problems where AI has to do more than simply work. Clinicians are overwhelmed by documentation. Coding errors, backlogs and denials cost health systems billions. And the specialist expertise patients need is not always available when they need it.

We build AI specifically for these environments, trained on real patient interactions, validated against real outcomes, and designed to perform where accuracy, trust and reliability matter. If you want to help define how AI is built for healthcare, you belong at Corti.

The Role

We’re looking for a GTM Engineer to help build the systems behind a smarter, more scalable go-to-market engine at Corti. You’ll connect the tools and data that power our commercial teams, turning fragmented systems into a reliable foundation for automation, insight, and action.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of software, data, and business impact. You’ll partner closely with Growth, Sales, DevEx Growth, and Platform to design workflows, improve data quality, and build the internal products and automations that help us move faster as we scale.

What you'll do

Data foundation

• Build and maintain the integrated data layer across Corti’s commercial data systems, bringing together data from tools such as Stripe, Attio, Supabase, Calendly, and Leexi.

• Own the event tracking layer, instrumenting key product and commercial touchpoints so analytics tools (PostHog, Mixpanel, etc.) reflect what's actually happening.

• Build enrichment pipelines that pull from third-party data providers and internal signals to keep ICP records current and scored.

Systems and automation

• Design and implement workflows, automations, and backend services that improve how commercial teams operate, from pipeline management and deal acceleration to post-sale handoffs.

• Identify repetitive GTM processes and systematically eliminate them through automation, freeing commercial teams to focus on higher-judgment work.

Cross-functional impact

• Document all built components so systems remain understandable and extensible as the team scales.

• Contribute to engineering quality through clean implementation, thoughtful code review, and cross-functional collaboration.

What you bring

jobs.description:
**Overview

**We are on a mission to ensure everyone has access to medical expertise, no matter where they are.

Half the world still lacks access to quality healthcare. Even in advanced systems, outcomes are uneven, and clinicians are overwhelmed. Medical knowledge grows faster than human capacity can keep up.

Corti exists to close that gap. Our AI platform expands access to medical expertise, reducing errors, restoring time to clinicians, and making care more affordable, accessible, and human again.

There is no quality healthcare without a quality dialogue, and no reliable AI without a strong foundation. Help us build both.

**Why Corti?

**Corti is the frontier lab for clinical-grade AI. We build world-leading models and infrastructure that power healthcare's most ambitious software - from EHR vendors and virtual care platforms to the health systems that care depends on. Today, Corti serves over 100 million patients annually, including the NHS.

Our flagship model, Symphony, is trained and validated on real clinical data from real patient interactions, and powers the clinical and administrative work that healthcare runs on.

We power the builders who are redefining how healthcare works, from startups creating new patient experiences to enterprises modernizing the systems that care depends on.

If you believe that AI purpose-built for medicine will define the next century of healthcare, you belong at Corti.

**The Role

**Are you a curious person, and interested in contributing to solving real problems in healthcare? Are you someone who loves the Golang programming language?

If so, we would love for you to become an integral part of a fun, autonomous, and team-oriented culture guided by shared values, a high bar for quality, and a willingness to experiment.

Join the Engineering team as a Senior Backend Engineer to be part of pioneering the development of healthcare products. Our team specifically focuses on developing software that assists the medical community within speech recognition. Your work will build the backend that helps the medics, nurses, and doctors learn from their calls to get better for each one. You will learn every day by working alongside experts in software engineering, machine learning, and data science—are you up for the adventure?

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Own the technical development of a product that differentiates Corti the most in the market

• Your development work will impact millions of medical consultations a year at a global scale

• Hands-on development of an innovative solution where design choices matter

• Collaborate across our product and platform teams to define and improve best practices across Corti

• Work with colleagues in design and code reviews

• Bridge technical communication between end-users, technical leads, and Corti engineers

• Contribute to a strong culture of development at Corti through mentorship of developers of all levels

**What You Bring

**

• Extensive experience as a backend developer

• Mastery of Golang

• Experience ideating and implementing features with high complexity

• Hands-on experience with cloud computing architecture and development

• Deep experience with software and product development processes - you have seen where problems can arise, know how to deal with them, and how they can be proactively avoided

• Experience running, monitoring, and operating REST, WebSockets, and GraphQL APIs

• You know what it takes to design intuitive and user-friendly APIs

• Experience with containers and orchestration tools

• A passion for writing clean and efficient code

• Understand what it takes to build integration with other systems used in healthcare would be a bonus

• Experience designing data storage solutions is a plus

• Experience with audio streaming is a big plus

• General knowledge of IP telephony, on a conceptual or protocol level would be favorable

**Life at Corti

**

• You will be reporting to the Senior Engineering Manager.

• The position is full-time and starts as soon as possible.

• Hybrid working environment in our Copenhagen Office

• Equipment provided by Corti

**Ready to dive into the world of Corti? Hit that 'Apply' button, and let's start working together on reshaping the dialogue in healthcare, making a real difference for millions of patient outcomes around the world.

Are you passionate about regulatory affairs and bringing innovative vaccines to patients worldwide? Would you like to shape global CMC strategies and support the expansion of our life-saving vaccines?

Then you could be our next Regulatory Affairs CMC Manager.

At Bavarian Nordic, we are committed to saving and improving lives by unlocking the power of the immune system. Our commercial product portfolio includes market-leading vaccines against smallpox, mpox, rabies, tick-borne encephalitis, typhoid fever, cholera, and chikungunya. We excel in R&D innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization, striving to improve people's health and quality of life worldwide while protecting our tomorrow.

**The role

**Your primary focus will be the continued global expansion of our chikungunya vaccine following its initial approvals in the US and Europe. You will play an important role in shaping the regulatory approach for new markets and supporting the vaccine throughout its lifecycle.

Working across R&D and Global Operations, you will provide clear regulatory direction, coordinate activities across functions, and help move complex regulatory priorities forward.

As Regulatory Affairs CMC Manager, you will join a skilled team of three colleagues responsible for global CMC regulatory activities. Based in Kvistgaard, you will report to the Senior Manager, Regulatory Affairs CMC. Occasional travel should be expected.

**Your Key Responsibilities

**

• Lead regulatory CMC strategies and submissions that enable our vaccines to be registered and launched in new countries worldwide

• Prepare and maintain high-quality scientific and regulatory documentation to support submissions to health authorities

• Act as a trusted regulatory partner to cross-functional teams, providing guidance on regulatory requirements and submission expectations

• Manage interactions together with the Global Regulatory Lead with global health authorities, including preparation of briefing materials and responses to regulatory questions

• Drive regulatory activities throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring that manufacturing, process, or product changes are effectively implemented and approved in global markets

**What We Are Looking For

**You hold an MSc or PhD in a scientific discipline such as Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Biology, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.

In addition, you bring:

• Approximately 8+ years of experience in Regulatory Affairs within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or vaccine industry

• Strong experience with global regulatory submissions and international health authorities

• Experience with CMC regulatory activities for biologics, vaccines, or complex pharmaceutical products

• Solid understanding of pharmaceutical development, manufacturing, and regulatory requirements

• Excellent scientific writing and authoring skills

• Strong project management and planning capabilities

• Fluency in written and spoken English

**Who You Are

**To succeed in this role, you are:

• A collaborative team player who enjoys working across functions and cultures

• Detail-oriented and able to manage complex documentation with a high level of accuracy

• Proactive, agile, and comfortable navigating changing priorities

• A strong stakeholder manager who can build trusted relationships across the organization

• Curious, solution-oriented, and motivated by making a global impact

**What We Offer

**You will join an international vaccine company with unique technology, dedicated colleagues, and a collaborative culture built on teamwork, openness, and scientific excellence.

We offer a flexible work environment, opportunities for professional development, and the chance to contribute to work with a meaningful global impact.

**Caught your interest?

**If you are ready to shape global regulatory strategies and help bring innovative vaccines to more patients worldwide, apply through our designated application platform. Applications submitted by email will not be considered.

Please note that visa sponsorship and relocation assistance are not available for this position.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

__Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

_For more information, visit _www.bavarian-nordic.com

jobs.occupation: Manager - Business Advisory and Project Management
jobs.description:
Drive meaningful impact across the life sciences industry.

As our next Manager - Business Advisory and Project Management, you will contribute to solving meaningful challenges across the life sciences industry. We offer specialised management consulting services, working with top-tier life sciences companies as well as biotech startups -locally and globally. From strategy development to hands-on implementation, we support our clients were impact matters most.

About the role

As a Manager - Business Advisory and Project Management, you will work closely with clients and colleagues to address complex challenges across the life sciences value chain. You will take ownership of your work and contribute to delivering solutions that create real, lasting impact. This is a Senior role designed to provide project and program leadership to deliver strategic technical solutions that address complex client issues in the Life Sciences industry. You will be handling implementation/migration projects and programs to achieve desired outcomes and ensure successful business growth. You will also seek new business opportunities to help BASE life science grow its presence within existing and new customers.

Additionally, you will contribute to internal initiatives and training to further strengthen BASE life science’s project and program management methodologies, approach, and tools.

You will lead teams consisting of multiple workstreams, which could include BASE/Infosys, external third party, or client stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in, project/program management and the ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications.

Your responsibilities include:

• Developing responses to Requests for Proposals (RfPs), ensuring adequate planning for scope, timelines and budget

• Monitoring project/program status including milestones, risks, issues, budgets, etc.

• Acting as a delivery escalation point and proactively ensuring escalations are handled promptly with a clear action and communication plan.

• Creating and delivering tailored communication based on audience, i.e., executive level summaries for client stakeholders, or senior executives in BASE life science, status reports at a project or program-level at a suitable cadence for team members

• Intervening, when necessary, to ensure costs, timelines and quality are on track.

• Lead a cross-functional team to deliver projects/programs to the required scope, on time, within budget, and to the satisfaction of our life science industry stakeholders.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders in the life science industry to understand their needs and translate them into executable plans for the project team.

• Develop plans, timelines, and budgets for projects/programs for which you are responsible.

• Track and report on project/program progress, identifying and mitigating risks as needed.

• Facilitate communication and collaboration between the project team, life science industry stakeholders, and other teams within BASE life science.

You bring:

• 5+ years of experience as a technical project/program manager within Regulatory, Clinical, Quality or other GxP areas in the life science industry.

• Successful track record of managing technically complex projects/programs such as software development, implementation of IT systems, data migrations, etc.

• Experience leading technical teams and delivering data driven projects/programs.

• Experience with project management tools such as JIRA, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project etc.

• Experience with Agile project management methodologies such as SAFe.

• Strong communication skills, both in writing, meetings and in presentations.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

Additionally, the ideal candidate has the following skills/certifications:

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification

• Experience selling either projects or products to clients.

• Experience working with Veeva Vault, SalesForce or similar technologies.

• Experience working with AI professionally

This position is offered in Denmark and Spain.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2015, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting company working exclusively in life sciences, built on a simple purpose: grow our people, and deliver real impact for our customers.

We don't think AI is a feature you bolt onto existing systems — we think it's the layer through which a life sciences company's strategy actually gets executed, end to end. Most of the industry is still proving AI can do one task at a time, function by function, pilot by pilot. We're building toward something bigger: AI that runs across clinical, regulatory, quality, and commercial work instead of stopping at the edges of a single application.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Spain, Switzerland, the UK, Germany, France, Italy, and the US, we work with top-10 pharma and ambitious biotechs alike, and with technology partners including Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Google, AWS, Microsoft, and Amass — turning that belief into deployed, compliant, sellable solutions, not slideware.

Why join BASE Life Science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact — grounded in five core values: team spirit, trust, openness, ambition, and execution.

• Ambition, encouraged through ownership and continuous learning.

• Execution — we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice.

• Openness — your ideas are heard, challenged constructively, and supported as you grow.

jobs.occupation: Field Services Engineer, EMEA (Denmark or Germany)
jobs.description:
Introduction

We are looking for a talented Field Service Engineer based in Ballerup, Denmark or in Southern Germany. The ideal candidate has a minimum of 7 years of experience in servicing and maintaining scientific, analytical, biomedical, or laboratory equipment**.

About the Role

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Field Service Engineer to join Sophion Bioscience’s small, dedicated service team.

You will work alongside curious, hands-on colleagues who solve problems, share knowledge, and support one another - even when working independently in the field.

The team values high-quality work, clear communication, and a straightforward, respectful customer experience. In this key role, you will ensure the reliable performance of our automated patch clamp and organ-on-a-chip instruments at customer sites. Your responsibilities will include troubleshooting, maintenance and repairs, system evaluations, customer training, and coordinating upgrades with cross-functional teams.

As an ambassador for Sophion, you will build strong customer relationships by communicating effectively and resolving technical issues promptly, helping drive the continued growth of Sophion Bioscience.

About Us

Since 2000 Sophion Bioscience has pioneered Automated Patch Clamping for ion channel research. Today, we specialize in automated solutions for pre-clinical life sciences.

We work closely with academic institutions, contract research organizations, and leading biotech and pharmaceutical companies to create effective assays for screening and characterization. Our solutions empower the study of drug targets and candidates at the bench, reducing development time in discovery and reducing risk in clinical trials.

Through the continued development of our Automated Patch Clamp portfolio (QPatch & Qube) and our new Organ On a Chip platform (Ethica), we offer uncompromised data quality in a user-friendly environment, from assay setup to advanced data analysis.

We are driven by curiosity, teamwork, and a genuine passion for helping scientists succeed. We work in an open and collaborative environment where people share knowledge freely, support each other across roles and borders, and take pride in doing things properly. Our culture is informal, trusting, and grounded in respect — for colleagues, customers, and the science we enable. Even as we grow globally, we remain a company where people feel welcome, included, and able to make a meaningful impact.

We are headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in the United States, Japan, and China.

What You'll Do

• Installation and Commissioning: Conducting on-site installation and commissioning of Sophion Automated Patch Clamp and Ethica M instrumentation, ensuring it meets the client's specifications and quality standards.

• Maintenance and Repairs: Performing routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs of QPatch, Qube and Ethica M systems to ensure uninterrupted functionality. Responding promptly to service requests and providing timely resolutions.

• Documentation: Creating detailed service reports, documentation, and maintaining accurate records of all service activities. Providing feedback to the engineering and R&D teams for continuous product improvement.

• Training: Providing training to clients on the proper usage, maintenance, and troubleshooting of Sophion automated patch clamp & Ethica M instrumentation, ensuring they have a clear understanding of its features and capabilities.

• Customer Support: Serving as a point of contact for technical support, addressing client inquiries, and maintaining strong relationships with customers to enhance satisfaction.

• Collaboration: Collaborating with the Sales, Application Science and Engineering teams to communicate client feedback, potential product enhancements, and identify opportunities for upselling additional services or products.

Who You Are

You are an experienced service professional with a passion for customer success, technical excellence, and being a team player. You thrive in a hands-on environment where no two days are the same and enjoy executing your day-to-day responsibilities in close collaboration with the rest of the Sophion team.

We imagine that you:

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Biomedical Engineering, a related field or equivalent certifications

• In-depth knowledge of liquid handling devices from various industry systems is a benefit.

• Experience with electrical and pneumatics preferred

• Must possess a good grasp of core engineering concepts which include the ability to read and interpret electrical/circuit Schematic drawings.

• Able to use test/measuring equipment like Digital Multimeter (DVM).

• Team player, critical thinker, and flexible for effective performance in the field.

• Experience with service management systems and processes

• Familiarity with the operation and maintenance of Festo pressure systems is a plus

• Manage MySQL and Oracle databases to ensure seamless system integration and performance.

• Network Configuration and Maintenance: configure and troubleshoot network setups, routers, and DHCP configurations to guarantee optimal system connectivity.

• Possess a basic understanding of Linux systems to address software and operating system-related challenges.

• Demonstrate excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities to address technical issues promptly.

• Communicate effectively with customers and colleagues, ensuring a positive and collaborative working place.

• Ability to travel 50-60% once initial training is complete.

How to Apply

Please apply via LinkedIn.

If you have questions about the role, you are welcome to contact the HR Director, Helene Fife, (+45 51 20 34 43).

Start Date

As soon as possible.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and close the recruitment process once we have found the right candidate. If this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Do you want a broad accounting role with significant responsibility and excellent development opportunities?

If you are an experienced accounting professional who enjoys taking ownership, working independently, and being part of a collaborative team, this could be exactly the opportunity you have been looking for.

At Gubra, we are experiencing continued growth and development. As our business expands, so do the opportunities for our employees to develop professionally and take on increasing responsibility. We are therefore looking for a Financial Accountant to join our Finance team and contribute to maintaining a high level of quality, compliance, and operational excellence across our group companies.

In this role, you will become part of our finance function where teamwork, trust, and continuous improvement are highly valued.

A broad accounting role with responsibility across multiple areas

As Financial Accountant, you will be responsible for a variety of accounting and controlling activities spanning day-to-day bookkeeping, reconciliations, month-end closing activities, reporting support, and audit preparation.

You will have ownership of your own areas while working closely with your colleagues in Finance. We take pride in supporting one another and working together to ensure successful month-end closings, reporting deadlines, audits, and daily operations.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Managing accounts receivable, including invoicing, cash registrations, reminders, and communication with customers' finance departments

• Maintaining and managing the fixed asset register, including verification of physical assets and correct accounting treatment

• Handling lease accounting in accordance with IFRS 16

• Performing foreign currency revaluations on currency accounts

• Acting as system owner for Corpay, PLEO, and e-conomic

• Preparing statutory and regulatory reporting, including submissions to Statistics Denmark and other authorities

• Supporting colleagues with accounting- and finance-related questions

• Participating in month-end closing activities, reconciliations, and audit preparation

• Contributing to process improvements, internal controls, and finance-related projects

• Supporting ad hoc tasks across the group's legal entities

As you grow in the role, you will have the opportunity to expand your responsibilities and actively influence how we develop our finance processes and controls.

An experienced accounting professional with a proactive mindset

Naturally, we are looking for someone with the right professional qualifications. However, your approach to work and collaboration is equally important.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership, follows through on commitments, and enjoys working in an environment that combines structured routines with changing priorities and deadlines.

In addition, you bring:

• You likely have 5+ years of experience from a finance function where you have worked independently with bookkeeping, reconciliations, month-end closing, and financial controls.

• Strong Excel skills and experience with financial systems

• A structured and detail-oriented approach to your work

• The ability to work independently and take responsibility for your areas

• A positive and collaborative mindset with a willingness to support colleagues across the organization

• Professional communication skills in both Danish and English, written and spoken

Experience from an international company with entities in multiple countries is considered an advantage, but not a requirement. Likewise, experience with Corpay, PLEO, and/or e-conomic is beneficial but not essential.

We are particularly interested in someone who is curious and analytical. You notice when something does not look right, investigate the underlying cause, and work proactively to find a solution rather than simply reporting the deviation.

Your new team

You will join a Finance team consisting of four colleagues, including yourself. We work closely together, share knowledge, and support one another in delivering high-quality financial operations.

The role can be structured as either a full-time or part-time position (32-37 hours per week), depending on your preferences and qualifications.

We look forward to welcoming a colleague who enjoys being part of a team while maintaining ownership of their own responsibilities.

What we offer

• A broad and independent role in a collaborative Finance team

• A full-time or part-time position (32-37 hours per week)

• Real responsibility and ownership from day one

• The opportunity to influence processes, workflows, and internal controls

• Flexible working arrangements, including the possibility of working from home

• Ongoing opportunities to develop your role and responsibilities

• An informal and positive working environment

• Dedicated colleagues and a strong team spirit

• Competitive salary based on qualifications

• Pension scheme and health insurance

• Start date as soon as possible, although we are happy to wait for the right candidate

About Gubra

Gubra is a disease-agnostic techbio company specialized in peptide-based drug discovery and development as well as preclinical contract research services striving for excellence at all levels. We insist on doing things efficiently - and often differently - to reach the results we aim for. Our vision is to become leaders in the path towards a more sustainable and healthier world. We do that by facilitating the discovery of new medicine, and by acting and inspiring others to fight the ongoing climate and biodiversity crises.

Gubra’s activities are focused on the early stages of drug development and are organised in two main highly synergistic business areas: Biotech and CRO Services. We generate our revenue by performing research for life science companies as well as by partnering projects from our discovery and development pipeline.

Our therapeutic focus is within metabolic and fibrotic diseases, and we specialize in in vivo pharmacology, ex vivo assays, drug profiling, histology, stereology and whole brain and organ imaging. In addition, we offer a full palette of advanced transcriptomics. Our ML/AI-driven peptide drug discovery platform streaMLine enables us to rapidly develop a peptide hit into a non-clinical candidate ready for development. Through a constant focus on high quality, scientific excellence, speed, and solid teamwork we have established ourselves as a highly professional and competent partner in the market.

People are our greatest asset, and our team consists of around 320 employees of which many are located in Hørsholm, Denmark. The mix of people from different cultures and educational backgrounds combined with our entrepreneurial mindset have greatly impacted our working environment, which is characterized by entrepreneurial drive, scientific curiosity, and teamwork – we join forces!
